sections.overview: Luciocyprinus langsoni is a freshwater carp of the cyprinid family, described from northern Vietnam and reported from China and Vietnam.
sections.identification: FishBase gives a reported maximum standard length of 79 cm and a published maximum weight of 15 kg; these are maxima, not typical adult sizes.
sections.habitat: Available summaries place it in freshwater, in a benthopelagic environment; detailed habitat preferences were not established in the sources reviewed.
sections.diet: The reviewed sources do not report its diet.
sections.behavior: The reviewed sources do not describe its behavior.
sections.reproduction: The reviewed sources do not describe its breeding.
sections.ecology: A 2024 mitochondrial-genome study reports two named species in Luciocyprinus: this species and L. striolatus; genetic data alone do not establish their ecological differences.
sections.conservation: A 2025 international freshwater-fish assessment table lists it as Vulnerable. Vietnam also includes it on a priority-protection list.
